targets.expr:
count(
  truss:device:xpu_usage
  and on(exported_namespace, exported_pod)
  label_replace(
    label_replace(
      vllm:generation_tokens_created{model_name="$isvc"},
      "exported_namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"
    ),
    "exported_pod", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"
  )
) by (device_type)

group by(taco_cluster, hostname, uuid, exported_namespace, exported_pod, card, model_name, pci_bus_id) (truss:device:xpu_power) and on(exported_namespace, exported_pod) label_replace(label_replace(vllm:generation_tokens_total{model_name="$isvc"}, "exported_namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "exported_pod", "$1", "pod", "(.*)")

avg( increase(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{taco_cluster=~"$cluster", model_name=~"$isvc"}[$__range]) /
increase(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{taco_cluster=~"$cluster", model_name=~"$isvc"}[$__range])) by (taco_cluster, namespace, pod)

avg( increase(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{taco_cluster=~"$cluster", model_name=~"$isvc"}[$__range]) /
increase(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{taco_cluster=~"$cluster", model_name=~"$isvc"}[$__range])) by (taco_cluster, namespace, pod)

avg( increase(vllm:time_per_output_token_seconds_sum{taco_cluster=~"$cluster", model_name=~"$isvc"}[$__range]) /
increase(vllm:time_per_output_token_seconds_count{taco_cluster=~"$cluster", model_name=~"$isvc"}[$__range])) by (taco_cluster, namespace, pod)
avg by (taco_cluster, card, hostname, device, device_type, exported_pod, pci_bus_id, uuid) (truss:device:xpu_temp{taco_cluster="$cluster"})
avg by (taco_cluster, card, hostname, device, device_type, exported_pod, pci_bus_id, uuid) (truss:device:xpu_usage{taco_cluster="$cluster"})
sum by (taco_cluster, card, hostname, device, device_type, exported_pod, pci_bus_id, uuid) (truss:device:xpu_power{taco_cluster="$cluster"})
avg by (taco_cluster, card, hostname, device, device_type, exported_pod, pci_bus_id, uuid) (truss:device:xpu_mem_usage{taco_cluster="$cluster"})
